chunks.text: Route of administration: Oral (US FDA 2023; de Jong et al. 2008; Chen et al. 2005; Davidson et al. 2001; US FDA 2001; Clifton et al. 2004; Hendriks et al. 2003; Hendriks et al. 1999; Westrate and Meijer 1998)

Dosage Form(s): This monograph excludes foods or food-like dosage forms as indicated in the Compendium of Monographs Guidance Document.
Acceptable dosage forms for oral use are indicated in the dosage form drop-down list of the web-based Product Licence Application form for Compendial applications.

Use(s) or Purpose(s): Helps lower blood total and low density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol (US FDA 2023; de Jong et al. 2008; Chen et al. 2005; Clifton et al. 2004; Hendriks et al. 2003; Davidson et al. 2001; US FDA 2001; Hendriks et al. 1999; Westrate and Meijer 1998).
Helps lower bad cholesterol (US FDA 2023; de Jong et al. 2008; Chen et al. 2005; Clifton et al. 2004; Hendriks et al. 2003; Davidson et al. 2001; US FDA 2001; Hendriks et al. 1999; Westrate and Meijer 1998).
Helps maintain healthy cholesterol levels (US FDA 2023; de Jong et al. 2008; Chen et al. 2005; Clifton et al. 2004; Hendriks et al. 2003; Davidson et al. 2001; US FDA 2001; Hendriks et al. 1999; Westrate and Meijer 1998).
Note: The above uses can be combined on the product label (e.g., Helps lower blood total and low density lipoprotein (LDL) cholesterol and maintain healthy cholesterol levels).

Quantity(ies): 0.8 - 4.8 grams of Plant sterol esters per day, including at least 80 % of Combined beta-Sitosterol, Campesterol and Stigmasterol, per day (US FDA 2023; de Jong et al. 2008; Chen et al. 2005; Clifton et al. 2004; Hendriks et al. 2003; EC 2002; Kerckhoffs et al. 2002; Davidson et al. 2001; US FDA 2001; Hendriks et al. 1999; Westrate and Meijer 1998).

Direction(s) for use: Take with a meal/food (US FDA 2023; de Jong et al. 2008; Chen et al. 2005; Clifton et al. 2004; Hendriks et al. 2003; Davidson et al. 2001; US FDA 2001; Hendriks et al. 1999; Westrate and Meijer 1998).
Caution(s) and warning(s): Ask a healthcare practitioner/health care provider/health care professional/doctor/physician before use if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.
